services.value: Provides cleanroom testing and certification, including cleanroom qualification and certification (e.g., particle counts, HEPA filter integrity/velocity, room air changes, room pressure, viable air sampling/surface sampling, and IQ/OQ/PQ). Also offers environmental monitoring services, including cleanroom qualification, controlled environment monitoring, water testing (e.g., bacterial endotoxins, conductivity, microbial counts, TOC), and compressed air/gas and air monitoring.
